emotional_tone: Cinematic, immersive, psychological dread, premium luxury gaming, atmospheric, oppressive.

headings.usage: H1, H2, hero titles, game titles, cinematic quotes. Must use tracking-tighter for impact.

subheadings.usage: Overlines, labels, tags, technical game stats, section markers. Must be uppercase with tracking-[0.2em].

body.usage: Paragraphs, game descriptions, UI elements, standard text.

typography.anti_patterns: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Avoid geometric sans for headings.

rules: No pure black (#000000) or pure gray (#808080). Tint neutrals with themes.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use solid dark colors with noise/grain.
Use high contrast for text (APCA standards).

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle film grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay or opacity-5) across the entire application to avoid a sterile digital look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and tooltips: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-2xl and a delicate border-white/5 inner stroke. No muddy grays.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid in specific technical sections using 1px border-white/5. Avoid thick borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal outer shadows. Emphasize inner glows and deep ambient drop shadows for hover states.
visual_enhancers.vignette: Use a radial gradient at the page edges (from transparent to black) to focus attention and create a claustrophobic feel.

grids.bento_grid: Mode A: Asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix hero items (col-span-8 row-span-2) with tall items (col-span-4 row-span-2). Never fill perfectly.
grids.game_catalog: High-density grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 or gap-6 for browsing.

layouts.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-16 for main sections. Dark cinematic margins.
layouts.cards: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or extremely minimal rounding (rounded-sm max 4px). No bubbly cards.
layouts.hero: Full-height (min-h-[90vh]) with heavy bg-black/50 overlay (or gradient to black) over cinematic imagery.

motion.transitions: Use transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), opacity 0.4s ease.
motion.hover: Subtle scale-up (scale-105) for game covers with brightness increase and shadow reveal. Text color shifts to white.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in and slight y-axis slide for game grids.
motion.parallax: Use on the Hero section background to create depth.

components.navigation: Sticky, Glassmorphic (Crystal variant). Includes logo, primary links, Search icon, and Theme Customization toggle (Fog/Blood/Eldritch).
components.game_card: Vertical poster aspect ratio (3:4 or 2:3). Image takes up 80% of card, info at the bottom. Hover reveals metadata.
components.buttons: Sharp-edged, pill or rectangle. In Blood theme: dark red with subtle glow. In Fog theme: muted zinc with white text. Minimal padding but impactful.
components.filters: Sidebar or top-bar using Shadcn UI select/checkboxes, styled aggressively dark with no generic white backgrounds.
components.search: Full-screen modal overlay with huge typography (Oswald) and live search results appearing as a dense list.

home.hero: Massive cinematic game cover. Title in Cormorant Garamond (text-7xl). CTA: 'View Details'. Overlay: heavy vignette.
home.trending: Horizontal scrolling carousel of game covers. Sharp, borderless cards.
home.featured_collection: Bento grid layout highlighting a curated list (e.g., 'Masters of Survival Horror').
home.genres: Minimalist text-based links or small stark icons, not colorful pills.

page_composition.browse: Sidebar for filters (Genres, Platforms, Rating, Year). Main content: Dense grid of game cards. Infinite scroll or pagination.
page_composition.game_details: Immersive hero image bleeding into header. Content below: Metacritic score, RAWG rating prominently displayed in imposing typography. Screenshots in a masonry or asymmetrical grid.
page_composition.favorites: Clean, high-density grid showing saved games.
page_composition.compare_games: Side-by-side data table, brutalist tech aesthetic.
page_composition.random_generator: A full-screen interactive experience. 'Dare to play' button with tense build-up animation before revealing a random horror game.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-shadow on text placed over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='theme-toggle-button').

media.images: High-contrast, desaturated, or deeply saturated reds/blues. Avoid bright, sunny, or cartoonish imagery.

3d_libraries: Framer Motion for complex layout transitions. Consider TSParticles for subtle floating 'ash' or 'fog' effects on the home page (if within scope, otherwise keep to CSS/Framer).

hero_backgrounds.description: Misty mountains, perfect for Silent Hill fog aesthetic
Dark forest path illuminated by moonlight, spooky vibe

game_collections.description: Foggy forest road for 'Lost in the Woods' collection

textures.description: Dark abstract texture for backgrounds or container overlays
Grainy abstract texture for cinematic film grain effect

instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate RAWG API for fetching horror games. Filter by tags like 'horror', 'survival-horror', 'psychological'.
Implement theme toggling (Fog, Blood, and Eldritch) via React Context and Tailwind classes.
Use Framer Motion for page transitions and hover effects.
Store favorites and recently viewed in localStorage.
Keep Shadcn UI components heavily customized to fit the brutalist/cinematic horror aesthetic. Strip out all default Vercel-style aesthetics.
DO NOT use transparent headers; use glassmorphism with dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or subtle rounding) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
